description: This Java class TS2C is a command line utility that converts a tuner studio project (MSQ file) into C data structures. It reads specific sections from an input file, processes tables and axis bins, and outputs a C-like array structure along with rpm and load bins.

classes.name: TS2C
classes.description: Main class performing conversion from tuner studio project files to C data structures, handling file input, parsing, and output formatting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the utility with command line arguments.

methods.name: TS2C
methods.description: Constructor that processes input arguments, reads data sections from input file, and generates output C array.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a float array to a string representation formatted as a C array.

methods.name: writeTable
methods.description: Writes a C array representing the table data, includes metadata like generation timestamp.

methods.name: readAndScroll
methods.description: Reads from a file until a specific string is found, to locate data sections within the input file.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Formats and writes a single line of table data to the output, including load and RPM indices.

methods.name: readTable
methods.description: Reads a table of floating point values from the input, populating a 2D float array.

methods.name: readAxle
methods.description: Reads a series of float values from input, populating a one-dimensional float array.
